caption: The drawing depicts a large, grayish-beige ceramic jar with two handles protruding near the neck. The jar is cylindrical with a slightly tapered bottom and a wide, open mouth, where the interior appears in a brownish hue. There is a painted or inscribed image of a black bird perched on a twig, which has two leaves, on the front surface of the jar. Above the bird, there is text in capital letters reading "D. GOODALE HARTFORD." There is a rough, irregular patch near the bottom right of the jar, indicating either a flaw or repair. The jar is set against a plain, light background. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset showing a detailed close-up view of one handle of the jar, revealing curvature and connection to the vessel. The artist's signature, "N. Amantea," appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
